title: Library, empty
summary: Dana's Library before she owns anything: the display h1, who she is signed in as, one empty state with the Locker mark, one line, Activate a license as the page's one ink primary and See 2 in Discover, and the sticky 'Missing a license?' strip, led by Activate a license (there is no key tile).
compare: 2026-10-20 redraw (PX-35, BR-lockups), to the owner-approved build: the header's Activate license button is gone (the account menu's first item, 'Activate a license'); the phone bar is Library · Discover, docked full width; the 'Polaris Locker · Help · Privacy' footer is gone (Help and Privacy are in the account menu); the header brand is the trimmed outlined Locker lockup at the guide's size (BR-lockups: 40 px tall in the 64 px header, 36 px under 761 px, the mark alone under 384 px); the empty state's button reads 'Activate a license' (the catalog's common.activateLicense) and is the one ink primary, now that the header repeats nothing; 'Missing a license?' is the sticky strip, led by 'Activate a license'.

One empty state: the Locker mark, 'Nothing here yet', Activate a license (the one primary) and 'See 2 in Discover' (outlined, with the count of products she can add) (portal-17). The two buttons wrap, never squeeze, at 320 px and at 200 % text.

The 'Missing a license?' strip ends the page (sticky to the window's bottom, so it shows at once): one line from 1180 px ('Activate a license', 'Another email? Add it in Sign-in methods', 'Bought on Steam? Connect Steam', 'Bought in a store? Sign in from the app'); a closed disclosure below 1180 px, on the bottom bar on a phone. The empty state takes the room between the title and it.
The subtitle says who is signed in, once; no count of zero products, no count on the Library tab.
The display h1 (48/52, 32/36 on a phone); the bottom bar's Library is the current tab on a phone.
